blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–When the Macau Giant Pandas wrap up their 2o26 PBA Governors’ Cup campaign on Friday against Converge, it will mark the last time the hapless guest team is going to see action in the league. PBA commissioner Willie Marcial ruled out any chances of a Macau return following a pitiful two-conference stint that hit a new low with their performances, or lack thereof, since the resumption of the season-ending conference. The Giant Pandas fell to 2-9 on Tuesday after nearly resetting their record for the most lopsided loss in PBA history when they fell to the TNT Tropang 5G, 142-87, […]...
